title: recall.extracted.v1
description: Structured, validated reading of one raw recall notice, produced by recall-extractor (LLM + deterministic guardrail). Consumer: resolution-service, which should prefer these fields over re-parsing raw text. Every UPC and lot code is guaranteed to appear in `text`; UPCs are check-digit-valid GTIN-14 unless listed in corrections as 'kept verbatim'. Wrapped in _envelope.v1.json; correlation_id = '<source>:<source_id>', causation_id = the raw event. Exchange ingestion.x, routing key ingestion.recall.extracted.v1.

raw_event_id.description: event_id of the recall.raw.received.v1 event this was extracted from

text.description: The exact notice text the model read (labelled sections). Auditors and consumers can verify every identifier against it.

brand.description: Consumer-facing brand on the package (may be a retailer private label), not the recalling firm.

upcs.description: GTIN-14 (zero-padded) when check-digit valid; otherwise the verbatim 12–14 digits, flagged in corrections

agent.description: organism / allergen / object, e.g. 'Listeria monocytogenes', 'peanut', 'glass pieces'

allergens.description: canonical lowercase names: milk, egg, peanut, tree nuts, soy, wheat, fish, shellfish, sesame, sulfites, mustard, celery, lupin, molluscs

confidence.description: model self-assessment, penalised by the validator for every dropped identifier; 0 products caps it at 0.3

evidence.description: short verbatim quotes supporting the key fields

corrections.description: what the guardrail changed and why (dropped/kept/added identifiers, normalised fields)
